summary: Describes a detailed model of IPv4 multicast with RSVP, built using the OPNET simulation package, with protocol procedures written in C. Researchers can use it to study how these protocols behave. It is informational.

eli5.summary: This is a pretend version of a network, built on a computer, for testing how sending to many receivers works with reserved bandwidth.

questions: is there a simulation model for multicast with rsvp
